subject: Clarify scope: 2028 Annual API Assurance engagement & evidence flow
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@securepath.com>, procure@acme-payments.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify scope: 2028 Annual API Assurance engagement & evidence flow

Hi Emma / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the proposal. I'm attaching our current SOW draft (SOW_Acme_API-Assurance_v1.2.pdf) and a redacted asset inventory (redacted_asset_inventory.xlsx). Before we lock dates I need a couple of clarifications from SecurePath so procurement can complete the PO and legal can review final terms: 

- Target scope: we listed "production API surface" and a subset of internal admin APIs. Can you confirm whether the engagement includes authenticated endpoint testing (you mentioned credentialed testing in the call) and whether you require short-lived service accounts or can use scoped tokens via our test harness?
- Evidence handling: we need an explicit evidence retention & destruction clause. Do you produce raw pcap/log exports, or only sanitized findings? How do you handle screenshots of customer data?
- CI/CD/agent access: will you need any CI runners or ephemeral agents in our environment, or will all tests be executed from your external infrastructure? If agents are required, what baseline privileges do they need?
- Timing & blackout windows: our production freeze is 03/20-03/25. Can you confirm you can run the main engagement outside that window and outline a proposed two-week testing window with re-test slot?
- Remediation verification: do you include one re-test cycle in the fixed price or is that billable hourly?

Please review the attached SOW and call out any clauses that would be problematic for Acme procurement (indemnity, data handling, insurance limits). Once we have these answers I can push the SOW to DocuSign and procurement will issue a PO.

Thanks — short bullets are fine.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Manager, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Acme_API-Assurance_v1.2.pdf (pdf, 412KB); redacted_asset_inventory.xlsx (xlsx, 56KB)

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@securepath.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, procure@acme-payments.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Mar 2028 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify scope: 2028 Annual API Assurance engagement & evidence flow

Hi Tessa — thanks for the clear list and the assets. Short answers below, longer clarifications in-line.

- Authenticated endpoint testing: Yes, we will perform credentialed testing for scoped endpoints. We prefer short-lived service tokens created for the engagement (best practice for auditing). We can accept scoped OAuth tokens if your engineering team prefers that workflow.
- Evidence: Our deliverable set includes a classified technical report, an executive summary, and an encrypted evidence bundle (raw logs/pcaps) retained for 90 days post-delivery unless you request earlier destruction. We can also provide a sanitized evidence package up-front for legal review. Screenshots containing customer PII are redacted per our data-handling SOPs.
- Agents/CI runners: Default model is testing from our external infrastructure (distributed test runners). If you prefer internal agents, we require a dedicated ephemeral VM with no persistent access and a local service account scoped to the testing subnet. Minimum privileges: network egress, ability to run traffic to listed hosts and ports.
- Timing: We can avoid the 03/20-03/25 freeze. Proposed testing window: 03/27 — 04/07 (two calendar weeks, including weekend bursts for high-load tests). Re-test slot: 04/15 — 04/19 (one-week window).
- Re-tests: One remediation verification pass is included in the fixed price if fixes are submitted within 30 days of the initial findings. Additional follow-ups are hourly.

Redlines to SOW v1.2 we recommend: add explicit 90-day encrypted retention and a clause for evidence handover with HMAC checksums; limit liabilities to direct damages and include mutual SLA credits for missed deadlines. Also attached a copy of our insurance certificate for procurement (insurance_cert_securepath.pdf).

If this works I'll send an itemized final quote (line items for web API testing, auth testing, credentialed attempts, social-engineering exclusion) and the redlined SOW via DocuSign next week.

Regards,
Emma Jones
Engagement Lead
SecurePath Security

Attachments: insurance_cert_securepath.pdf (pdf, 48KB); SecurePath_SOW_redlines.pdf (pdf, 78KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@securepath.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, procure@acme-payments.com
Date: Mon, 05 Mar 2028 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify scope: 2028 Annual API Assurance engagement & evidence flow

Thanks Emma — appreciate the quick responses. A few internal follow-ups / constraints from engineering/legal before we commit: 

- Token provisioning: Dev — can infra generate short-lived scoped tokens for SecurePath, or will we need to create a service account? If tokens, what TTL is reasonable? (Suggest 12 hours).
- CI/CD: we cannot run external agents inside our CI runners. If SecurePath needs an internal runner, it must be provisioned inside our dedicated test VPC only (no access to prod secrets). Emma: confirm the ephemeral VM approach requires no KMS access and that all logs are stored to a customer-owned S3 bucket.
- Evidence retention/legal: Legal flagged the 90-day raw evidence retention — they prefer 30 days unless we sign an addendum. Vivek: please confirm if we can accept 90 days or push back.
- Invoice terms: procurement needs the final quote with line items and the order of magnitude for any extra re-test hours so PO can include a contingency.

If SecurePath can sign the redlined point about no KMS/HSM access and evidence delivered encrypted to our S3 with a customer-side key, procurement will proceed. Otherwise we need to escalate to Vivek and legal for exceptions.

Marissa
Head of AppSec Programs
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Clarify scope: 2028 Annual API Assurance engagement & evidence flow

Emma — thanks. Based on the answers below and internal alignment we can proceed with the proposed schedule, with the following conditions before we sign: 

1) Update SOW to reflect 30-day raw evidence retention by default; SecurePath to offer 90 days with a signed addendum (legal preference).
2) No KMS/HSM access for external testers; encrypted evidence to be delivered to our S3 using a customer-side key.
3) One remediation verification pass included; additional follow-ups hourly — procurement will include a $10k contingency line in the PO for extra hours.
4) Final itemized quote required for PO: separate line items for credentialed auth testing, brute-force auth attempts, and load-spike testing.
5) DocuSign link to updated SOW and SecurePath final quote. Procurement please confirm net-30 and reference ACME-2028-PEN1 on the PO.

Procurement / Emma: if you can push the updated SOW and quote by EOW (03/10) we will route to legal and approve the PO. Emma — appreciate the insurance cert.

I'll follow up once the DocuSign is in place.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Manager, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
